# Villa Zen'O

> Luxury holiday villa in the Palmeraie of Marrakech, Morocco. Official site: https://www.villazenomarrakech.com

Villa Zen'O is a single-level private villa for up to 8 guests (4 bedrooms, 5 beds, 4.5 bathrooms) in the Palmeraie of Marrakech, between Palais Namaskar and Palais Ronsard, near the Oberoi and Palais Rhoul. Plus code (approximate map pin): M3GR+M5M, Marrakech.

## Key facts
- 18-metre heated outdoor infinity pool (heating optional, 90 EUR per day, confirm 48 hours ahead)
- Outdoor heated jacuzzi for 8 (heating optional, 35 EUR per day, confirm 48 hours ahead)
- Bedrooms: The Sand Master, The Palm Suite, The Atlas Suite (twin beds), The Blue Desert Suite — each with a private bathroom, arranged around a century-old olive tree
- Atlas mountain views; contemporary architecture with Moroccan tradition
- Fibre wifi included, free parking, fireplace, PS5, foosball, ping-pong, fitness corner, baby cot and high chair
- House staff included: daily housekeeping, cook and housekeeper 09:00–17:00, pool maintenance, gardening, 24-hour discreet security
- Mama Fouzia cooks Moroccan breakfast (10 EUR/person, 09:00–12:00), lunch (15 EUR, 12:00–16:00) and dinner (20 EUR, 19:00–21:00), or cooks groceries the guests buy at no extra service charge. Please order the day before.
- Deliveries 10 EUR each, 09:00–21:00; no alcohol delivery
- Check-in from 15:00, check-out before 11:00
- No loud music or parties from 00:00 to 08:00; no unlisted extra guests
- Name is a nod to Dragon Ball Z; a Sangoku (Son Goku) statue stands in the garden

## Getting around
- Jemaa El-Fna / Medina: 16 minutes by Uber on a recorded trip (104 MAD UberX / 151 MAD UberXL in the evening)
- Royal Golf Marrakech: 16 minutes (95 MAD UberX / 139 MAD UberXL on the same type of screenshot)
- Camel ride from the door: 200 MAD/hour; quad: 300 MAD/hour (+50 MAD if two share); confirm the day before. Horse riding club tours from the villa.
- Airport transfers and private driver on request
